content: redb (pure-Rust, mmap-based, LMDB-inspired, copy-on-write B-trees) is the closest in-ecosystem precedent for a correctness-first mmap store in Rust, near-LMDB speed. sled deliberately avoids mmap for its main store, consistent with DBMS literature caution ('Are You Sure You Want to Use MMAP in Your DBMS?') about torn pages, page-cache tail latency, and crash-consistency hazards.
